name: import-stl-tag
description: The keychain tag from a binary STL file (SketchBillet's own export, 160 triangles), made into a solid. Its volume is the mesh's own, worked out in Python from the file's triangles (sum of a.(b x c)/6): 7121.858317 mm^3, a little more than the exact tag's 7121.46 because the hole is faceted. The flat sides merge into one face each: 4 sides, top and bottom, and the faceted hole's 36 strips = 42 faces.
